quotations.old_english: Óslác, gamolfeax hæleð, wís and wordsnotor
Ne weorþeþ on wornlde ǽnig wordsnotera ne on wordum getingra, ðonne hé (Antichrist) wyrðeþ

source_text: word-snotor; adj. Expert in speech, eloquent, learned :-- Óslác, gamolfeax hæleð, wís and wordsnotor, Chr. 975 ; Erl. 126, 21. Lýfing se wordsnotera biscop, 1047; Erl. 171, 28. Wordsnoteran (Homerum), Hpt. Gl. 463, 53. Wordsnotere oratores, rhetores, grammatici, 481, 72. Wordsnoterum sapientium, 503, 67. Ne weorþeþ on wornlde ǽnig wordsnotera ne on wordum getingra, ðonne hé (Antichrist) wyrðeþ, Wulfst. 54, 21.
